opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: Look up a country on World Bank Open Data (GDP, growth, population) and Wikipedia (capital, currency), then write a '<Country> macro snapshot' email to a recipient summarizing the figures.
steps: Open World Bank Open Data and type {country} in the search box, select the country
Read GDP (current US$), GDP growth, and total population from the country page
Open Wikipedia, search {country}, open the article
Read capital and currency from the infobox
Set Body = 'Hi {recipient_name}, {country}: GDP US${gdp} ({year}), growth {growth}%, population {population} ({year}); capital {capital}, currency {currency} ({code}).'
Send (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

opportunities.name: Log a Gutenberg book with author info to notes
opportunities.description: Search Project Gutenberg for a book title, open the book page for its release date and download count, look up the author's birth and death years on Wikipedia, and add a 'Read:' note.
steps: On Project Gutenberg, type {book_title} in the quick search box and press Enter
Open the top result and note the author, release date and downloads (last 30 days)
On Wikipedia, search {author} and read their birth and death years
Type 'Read: {book_title} by {author} ({birth}-{death}), Gutenberg since {release_date}, {downloads} downloads' and press Enter
